Definition: from G3464; to apply (perfumed) unguent to:--anoint.
BiblicalUsage: Myrizo means to anoint with perfumed oil — she hath done what she could, Jesus says, she is come aforehand to anoint My body to the burying.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the anointing is the act that understands what the disciples do not: she sees the burial coming, and she honours it beforehand.
